headline: Foreigners Flock to 10 Stocks as IHSG Rallies
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index rose 1.35% to 5,215.85 on Monday, 23 November, after a weak prior week. Foreign investors bought ten named stocks.
why: The Jakarta Composite is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, so its daily moves signal local equity sentiment. Foreign net buying is closely watched as a gauge of international investor interest.
why_moved: Foreign investors were net buyers of several stocks after a weak prior week, according to the report.
original_headline: Asing Serbu 10 Saham Ini saat IHSG Melaju
